text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp.
To support us through 
the tough training,
food stalls were setup so 
we could grab a bite to eat during breaks.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
All the veggies at this stall are really good,
huh~. 
The flavor is rich,
and they've got a nice shape.

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
Gahahaha! I'm glad you're enjoying them! 
Harvesting them was worth it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Eh!? Old man, you grew these!? 
Amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
Got that right! They turned out pretty well,
huh? I like to 
think that I'm pretty good at growing
vegetables! Gahahaha!

I wonder just what his field looks like.
As a beginner 
I was interested,
and before I could stop myself――
choice_data_list: Can we take a look at your field!?

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text: Huh?

There were many well-maintained rows and
even a hand-made scarecrow.
As someone who's become 
interested in this,
the scenery is exciting.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for a bird repellant,
this is really good! ……Old man! 
Do you think you could make one of these
for us too?

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing! ……But you know,
I never expected a student from that 
world famous Tracen Academy would be working
a field as a hobby……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It's way smaller than this one here
though! 
But, when it comes to flavor,
I'm confident! Right, Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! ……But,
I'm pretty particular about my tomatoes! 
Want to take a look?

After that,
we exchanged advice and opinions, 
then promised to help with the harvest
tomorrow morning.
However――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……The storm's gotten stronger huh? 
How'd the evacuation go?
choice_data_list: Seems like it's going fine so far

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see. That's good then. 
…………

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah……but,
at this point all you can do is wait.
Going out to 
check on your fields at a time like this is
out of the question.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
According to the forecast this'll be over
by morning, 
and then we can go take a look.
We made a promise, after all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Good morning……yesterday was something,
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
……Yeah. So you guys still came. 
It's as you can see. There's nothing left.

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
Nature is pretty fearsome, isn't it!? 
Humans are no match for it! Hahaha……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That's true……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
But, standing here worrying about it won't
fix anything―― 
Alright!
Then what should we start cleaning up
first!?

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text: ……Ha?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Right! But,
debris in the water might clog up 
the drainage,
so we'll have to clean that up first……
choice_data_list: I'll go borrow some things we need!

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on a minute! Are you serious!? 
There's no way we can repair the field if
it's like this……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Then, are you going to give up?

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!
……Of course I don't want to give up! 
But, but you see――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Then there's no reason to hesitate!
If you've got a goal in mind, 
then there's nothing left but to move
forward――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
A small setback like this,
we'll blow it away! 
Then next year,
you can treat us to something tasty again!

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
B-both of you……sniff――ah, damnit! 
If you say something like that,
then I can't help but get fired up!

text_block_list.name: Local
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
let's do this! I was looking to fix 
things from the ground up anyways!
At this point, 
we might as well smash it all and power
up!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad~,
looks like were able to make it work!
That old man, 
halfway through he had gotten back on his
feet and was having fun.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Trainer-san,
seems like you've gotten a 
bit more reliable~.
Even though in the very 
beginning you fell on your butt because of
a bug.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
But even so, 『It was fun』,
huh? ……If Trainer-san had been 
around at that time,
I probably would have been having fun too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Some time before I met Trainer-san, 
there was a day where the rain was extremely
heavy.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just like with this time,
when I went to check on the field 
in the morning,
and everything was just one big mess……

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That was the first time I'd seen a field
left like that 
on my own. Usually I had my family with me,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There was never a day where I wanted to 
just leave and go home more than that day.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If everyone was there,
then we'd all be saying how 
awful it was. But,
together we'd end up getting all muddy,
but we'd be laughing the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……But! 
I don't think a day like that will ever come
again.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (After all――)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
After all, Y'see―― 
I've got Trainer-san with me!

Katsuragi Ace had that mischievious smile
on her face again.
The look she gave me this time, 
had none of the shadows of doubt from
before.
choice_data_list: Of course! ……Just look at these bi...
Of course! ……Just look at these bi...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm~……biceps? Where? 
Pretty sure if anyone had them,
it would be me――

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Pfft,
you've got a really frustrated look on your
face! 
Kukukuu……Ahahahahahaa!!

I couldn't help but laugh along with Katsuragi
Ace. 
Maybe that's why I realized,
I was suddenly really tired.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……Fuwaaa~~ 
Fufu, Trainer-san,
I see you passed that yawn along.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll take it easy for a little bit
longer……
it's nice and sunny still too……

text_block_list.name: Ace's Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Waah!
Ace and Trainer-san are leaning against each
other 
and sleeping?
Ehh~ it's just like a youthful drama~♪

text_block_list.name: Ace's Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, they get along so well~. 
I'll snap a pic and show her later.
